title: Vihusishi (Theme 3: Utunzaji wa wanyama)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child compares with kuliko or zaidi ya (more), kama or sawa na (equal), and uses na for "with/and" correctly.
representations: pictures of animals of different sizes
steps: Choose kuliko / zaidi ya or kama / sawa na.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "kuliko" and one sentence with "sawa na".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kihusishi kipi kinalinganisha?" Kwa nini "pamoja na" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Katika "Alikuja na rafiki yake", na inaonyesha nini?" Kwa nini "ulinganisho" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kihusishi kipi kinalinganisha vitu viwili?" Kwa nini "kwa ajili ya" si jibu sahihi?
Ni sawa au mmoja ni zaidi?
misconceptions.repair: Tunalinganisha kwa kuliko au zaidi ya: mkubwa kuliko kiboko.

checks.question: Jaza: Juma ni hodari ___ kaka yake. (sawa)
Jaza: Mbwa wangu ni mkubwa ___ wako.
